title: Jonah and the House
author: Gideon Lockridge
blurb: Odile Joubert, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
